subject: Different results for ordered = TRUE versus estimator = "WLSMV"

messages.author: 580c1540ff71f5be
messages.subject: Different results for ordered = TRUE versus estimator = "WLSMV"
parts:
Dear all, 

Why are the results when using ordered = TRUE, missing = "pairwise" different than the results when using estimator = "WLSMV", missing = "pairwise"? Isn't the default for ordered = TRUE supposed to be DWLS estimation (WLSMV)?

Thank you in advance. 

A.

messages.subject: Re: Different results for ordered = TRUE versus estimator = "WLSMV"
parts: WLSMV can be used with continuous variables too. So, if you do not indicate which variables are ordered, lavaan estimate intercepts for them instead of thresholds, and Pearson correlations instead of polychoric correlations.
